name: antigravity-companion-monorepo
description: Remote companion and permission interceptor for Google Antigravity CLI

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@agy-companion/protocol && npm run build --workspace=@agy-companion/cli && npm run build --workspace=@agy-companion/web && npm run build --workspace=antigravity-companion
scripts.install:ext: npm run build:ext && npm run package:ext
